shishan_code_reward_draw_effect = {
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_1 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_2 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_3 value = 0 }
shishan_code_reward_pick_1_effect = yes
shishan_code_reward_pick_2_effect = yes
shishan_code_reward_pick_3_effect = yes
}

shishan_code_award_reward = {
if = { limit = {
has_origin = origin_shishan_code
has_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_ticket_ready
NOT = { has_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_pending } }
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_ticket_ready
shishan_code_reward_initialize_effect = yes
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_rerolled
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_prefer_new
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_old_1 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_old_2 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_old_3 value = 0 }
shishan_code_reward_choose_tier_effect = yes
if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_tier value > 0 } }
set_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_pending
shishan_code_reward_draw_effect = yes
shishan_code_reward_open_window_effect = yes }
else = { shishan_code_architecture_award_repeat_effect = yes country_event = { id = shishan_code.1002 } }
}
}

shishan_code_reward_finish_effect = {
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_pending
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_window_open
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_rerolled
remove_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_prefer_new
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_1 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_2 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_3 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_old_1 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_old_2 value = 0 }
set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_old_3 value = 0 }

shishan_code_reward_refresh_effect = {
shishan_code_reward_initialize_effect = yes
if = { limit = { has_origin = origin_shishan_code has_country_flag = shishan_code_reward_pending }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_1 value = 1 } NOT = { shishan_code_reward_eligible_01 = yes } } set_variable = { which = shishan_code_reward_slot_1 value = 0 } }
